text: A dependency stage reaches its container as a tar stream whose entries are owned by root, for installation and checks alike (#485). The container runs as root with every capability dropped, and docker cp keeps the host's uid, which that root can't write into, so preparation failed on any host where the watcher isn't root. Root-owned entries it can write. An opt-in test, INVARIANT_PLUMBING_DEPENDENCIES_REAL=1, prepares Go, Python and TypeScript parts from the pinned images with one real dependency each, runs their tests offline and reuses each environment without installing again; it passed on a macOS host as uid 501.
